requirement: Verify beneficial ownership of the proposed collateral lot.
verification_method: Ownership documents and independently corroborated custody records
failure_consequence: Decline and assign zero collateral credit.
completion_output: Verified ownership package with independent custody corroboration.

requirement: Confirm no prior lien and first-priority perfected security.
verification_method: Lien search, executed security documents, and legal confirmation
failure_consequence: Decline and assign zero collateral credit.
completion_output: Clear lien search, executed security documents, and legal confirmation.

requirement: Establish enforceable lender control over the collateral and custody account.
verification_method: Executed control agreement and operating-procedure test
failure_consequence: Decline and assign zero collateral credit.
completion_output: Executed control agreement and successful control-procedure test.

requirement: Test the Base-to-liquidation-to-bank repayment route end to end.
verification_method: Read-only route test with timestamps, fees, and destination confirmation
failure_consequence: Decline if no approved collateral-to-bank repayment route exists.
completion_output: Timestamped end-to-end route test with reconciled fees and destination proceeds.

requirement: Obtain and reconcile a current 13-week borrowing-entity cash forecast.
failure_consequence: Keep funding blocked and do not finalize the obligor cap.

requirement: Document facility purpose and a controlled use-of-proceeds schedule.
verification_method: Approved sources-and-uses schedule tied to facility documents
failure_consequence: Keep funding blocked until permitted use and controls are documented.
completion_output: Approved sources-and-uses schedule tied to facility documents.

requirement: Map legal-entity cash ownership and transfer restrictions.
verification_method: Entity chart, account map, and restriction review
failure_consequence: Keep funding blocked and do not rely on consolidated cash for repayment.
completion_output: Legal-entity chart, account map, and transfer-restriction analysis.

requirement: Reconcile the complete debt-service and maturity schedule.
verification_method: Debt schedule tied to agreements, filings, and forecast cash flows
failure_consequence: Keep funding blocked and do not finalize repayment capacity.
completion_output: Complete debt-service and maturity schedule reconciled to agreements and forecast cash flows.

requirement: Confirm current single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity.
verification_method: Current portfolio report and limit-owner sign-off
failure_consequence: Keep funding blocked and do not allocate portfolio capacity.
completion_output: Current portfolio exposure report with limit-owner sign-off.
